entries.title: Scrum map as agent operational reference
entries.what_changed: Added scrum-meridian-map.md with synthesis diagram and rules; moved scrum-guia-completo to kit as human-only; wired agents/templates; monitor How it works section; closed US-0088 in v2.01.
entries.why_changed: Scrum guide was added for humans but agents could load it every session and invent non-Meridian artifacts (tasks folders, story points).
entries.impact: Agents use map only unless manager asks for full guia; INVEST R14 and sprint priority documented without schema changes; EPIC-06 active for v2.01.
